chapters.title: Ash Field
chapters.text: Clear the impact scar; grow pioneer herbs.

chapters.title: Meadow Keepers
chapters.text: Bring sheep by Ark and graze a meadow; install bees.

chapters.title: Bramble Wall
chapters.text: Rest the land; open the scrub with goats or fire.

chapters.title: Pine Shield
chapters.text: Pines nurse young oaks; save saplings from the windthrow storm.

chapters.title: Riverbank
chapters.text: Dig the stream; willows hold the bank; frogs return; water turns drinkable.

chapters.title: Climax
chapters.text: Hold a 0-1-2-3 mosaic and brew Climax Tea at the old stump.

chapters.title: Seed Rain
chapters.text: The Great Oak drops one Climax Seed. Acorns fall 0.6 km at most, and the bare islet is 2 km out. Feed the jays, load the Ark Raft, and light the Islet Beacon: the climax forest must start again somewhere new.

chapters.title: Fire Keeper
chapters.text: The islet is green, but the home island is turning into one dark oak wood and the meadow herbs are going. Light the Fire Altar and choose how often the land burns: never and the oaks take everything, every year and nothing grows past grass. Find the middle.

chapters.title: Keystone Beaver
chapters.text: Beavers are back on the stream. A dam floods the cells around it into wetland: a new habitat for reeds, frogs and herbs. Too many dams, or one beside the old oaks, and the great trees drown. Place exactly the right dams.
